name: Garni Eveline
beschreibung: The Garni Eveline is located in the center of Ischgl, just a few minutes' walk from the Silvretta Seilbahn. The surroundings are characterized by the impressive mountain backdrop of the Silvretta-Gruppe. The inn offers a traditional Tiroler atmosphere with personal service. Guests can expect cozy accommodation with comfortably furnished rooms. In winter, visitors benefit from the proximity to the ski areas of Ischgl. In summer, the surrounding hiking trails and mountain bike routes invite you to activities in nature. The quiet location also allows for a relaxing stay away from the hustle and bustle.
